title: DivorceReportRecord
description: Standardized schema for civil divorce reports, divorce decrees, court docket entries, and annulments.

description.description: [REQUIRED] Human- and AI-readable contextual summary of this divorce record (e.g., '1928 Divorce of William Lehman and Annie Myers (Cumberland Co., PA)').

source_urn.description: Unique Uniform Resource Name adhering to URN:DIVORCE:[YEAR]:[JURISDICTION]:[LOCATOR].

record_category.description: Restricted to LEGAL for all court and civil divorce source records.

record_type.description: Granular classification of the legal divorce instrument.

court_name.description: Full formal court title (e.g., 'Court of Common Pleas of Cumberland County', 'Circuit Court').

docket_number.description: Docket, case, term, or file number assigned by the court. Should align with patterns under 'locator_divorce_patterns' in schemas/naming/_token_registry.json.

state_file_number.description: State department of health or vital statistics filing number.

jurisdiction.description: County seat or municipal jurisdiction where the court sat. Must align with 'jurisdictions' and 'counties' in schemas/naming/_token_registry.json.

presiding_judge.description: Name of the presiding judge, magistrate, or appointed divorce master.

clerk.description: Name of the prothonotary, court clerk, or register.

person_id.description: Controlled foreign key referencing the master Person Registry (/data/entities/people.json). Must be verified with 3 corroborating data points before assignment.

full_name.description: Husband's name parsed canonically or transcribed via raw_name.

age.description: Reported age or chronological age record at the time of divorce filing.

residence.description: Husband's place of residence at the time of the proceeding. Must standardize jurisdiction levels.

person_id.description: Controlled foreign key referencing the master Person Registry (/data/entities/people.json). Must be verified with 3 corroborating data points before assignment.

full_name.description: Wife's married or legal name parsed canonically or transcribed via raw_name.

maiden_name.description: Wife's maiden surname as stated in the court pleadings or decree.

age.description: Reported age or chronological age record at the time of divorce filing.

residence.description: Wife's place of residence at the time of the proceeding. Must standardize jurisdiction levels.

date_of_marriage.description: Date of initial marriage as certified in the divorce libel/complaint.

place_of_marriage.description: Jurisdiction where the marriage originally took place.

date_of_separation.description: Date cohabitation ceased as alleged by the complainant.

number_of_minor_children.description: Number of dependent children resulting from the union.

date_decree_granted.description: Official date the final decree was signed and entered into the court record.

legal_grounds.description: Statutory cause alleged or proved (e.g., 'Desertion', 'Cruel and Barbarous Treatment', 'Adultery', 'Indignities to the Person').

plaintiff.description: Party filing the petition or complaint for divorce.

enum: Bed and Board (A Mensa Et Thoro)

custody_details.description: Terms of child custody awarded in the final judgment.

alimony_awarded.description: Indicates whether spousal support or alimony was ordered.

record_note.description: Optional archival or legal notes regarding docket annotations, jurisdictional quirks, or case packet condition.

transcript.description: Structured verbatim abstract of the libel, testimony summary, or final decree, search keywords, word count, and text quality rating.

media_files.description: Array of original document or packet scans located in /data/media/.

associated_people.description: Array of canonical participants (husband, wife, presiding judge, master, attorneys, co-respondent, witnesses) linked to their standardized roles and master person IDs.
